sentences.en: To combat climate change, every town needs a dedicated arborist.
sentences.zh: 为了应对气候变化，每个城镇都需要一个专门的护林员。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to combat the expansion of the Sahara desert.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要阻止撒哈拉沙漠的扩张。

sentences.en: We should play a more active role in combating global warming.
sentences.zh: 我们应该在对抗全球变暖方面发挥更积极的作用。

senses.zh: 与……战斗；防止，抑制（尤用于新闻报道）
